decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship product line with high sunk investment, visibility, and centrality to the firm's announced direction, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal highly unlikely.
It has received investment and a dedicated page, but it is not a flagship and its results are unclear, so while escalation of commitment favors keeping it, the probability of dropping is moderate.

Being close to the established offer and presented on its own page gives it moderate visibility and centrality, so escalation of commitment suggests keeping it with a somewhat lower withdrawal probability than D.
